name: Myrna A Munoz

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Munoz lists her occupation as educator, small business owner, university adjunct and bi-literacy coach, with a background as a bilingual educator, school principal and education specialist.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Educator, Small Business Owner, University Adjunct, Bi-literacy Coach Occupational Background: Bilingual Educator: Preschool through Graduate School, Public school principal, Education specialist, Small business owner

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39

bio.statement: Munoz lists a bachelor's degree from UC Berkeley, a master's from Concordia and an educational leadership credential from Portland State University.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: A/B (UC Berkeley), MA (Concordia), Educational Leadership Credential (PSU)

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39

bio.statement: Munoz lists precinct committee person as her prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Precinct Committee Person

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39

positions.statement: In a press release quoted by OPB (May 2026), Munoz said data center tax breaks benefit large corporations while working families absorb the cost.
positions.excerpt: They are about giving massive, long-term tax breaks to some of the wealthiest corporations in the world

source.publisher: OPB

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Munoz says she will fight for public schools, citing her background as an educator.
positions.excerpt: As an educator from a family of educators, I understand quality education, & I'll fight for our public schools.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39

positions.statement: Munoz says she will stand up against ICE and federal overreach.
positions.excerpt: I will stand up against ICE and federal overreach and protect our healthcare system and access to abortion.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39

positions.statement: Munoz says she will protect the healthcare system and access to abortion.
positions.excerpt: protect our healthcare system and access to abortion

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39

positions.statement: Munoz says she will close tax loopholes and have large corporations pay their fair share, to invest in schools, healthcare and affordable housing.
positions.excerpt: I'll close tax loopholes and make sure large corporations pay their fair share so we can invest in schools, healthcare and affordable housing

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39

positions.statement: Munoz says she will work to shift the economy toward one that works for working people and protects the environment.
positions.excerpt: I will work to shift our economy to one that works for working people and protects the environment

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39

positions.statement: Munoz says she wants to keep Oregon away from data centers.
positions.excerpt: keeping us away from dangerous threats like data centers

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 39
